WITH rates AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."numge1500",
        s."numtsttakr",
        CASE
            WHEN s."numtsttakr" IS NULL OR s."numtsttakr" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE s."numge1500"::numeric / s."numtsttakr"::numeric
        END AS excellence_rate
    FROM "satscores" s
),

top_rates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r."excellence_rate"
    FROM rates r
    WHERE r."excellence_rate" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r."excellence_rate" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 3
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    sc."phone"
FROM "schools" sc
JOIN "satscores" s ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
JOIN rates r ON r."cds" = s."cds"
JOIN top_rates tr ON tr."excellence_rate" = r."excellence_rate"
WHERE sc."phone" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."phone";

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname1") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT "fname", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "fname"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)

SELECT nc."fname", an."district", COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an."fname" = nc."fname"
GROUP BY nc."fname", an."district"
ORDER BY nc."fname", district_count DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH school_scores AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."sname",
        s."dname",
        s."cname",
        s."avgscrmath",
        s."avgscrread",
        s."avgscrwrite",
        (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") AS total_avg

      AND s."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    AVG(ss."avgscrwrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."phone" AS phone_number
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" ss
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE
    
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate" <> '' AND s."opendate" > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR
    
    (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate" <> '' AND s."closeddate" < DATE '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY
    s."school",
    s."phone"
ORDER BY
    avg_writing_score DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."closeddate" <> ''
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.closed_count DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."county",
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc
  ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."school";

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."numge1500"
    FROM "satscores" ss

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT

    t."numge1500",
    adm."full_name"
FROM top_school t
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = t."cds"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
        (s."admfname1", s."admlname1"),
        (s."admfname2", s."admlname2"),
        (s."admfname3", s."admlname3")
) AS adm("fname", "lname")
WHERE adm."fname" IS NOT NULL AND adm."lname" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY adm."lname", adm."fname";
